title: MemoryBook
description: MemoryBook records important SMP milestones and turns your Minecraft server history into an in-game timeline, GUI, and written book.
body:
# MemoryBook

MemoryBook is a Minecraft SMP history plugin that records important server milestones and turns them into a living timeline.

It is designed for SMP servers that want to preserve memorable moments, player achievements, and community history across a season. Instead of losing important events in chat, MemoryBook saves them so players can view them later through commands, a GUI, or an in-game written book.

## Features

- Automatically records important milestones
- Tracks first player join
- Tracks first Nether entry
- Tracks first End entry
- Tracks first Ender Dragon kill
- Tracks first Wither kill
- Allows admins to add custom memories
- Provides an in-game timeline with `/timeline`
- Provides a history GUI with `/history`
- Gives players a written Memory Book with `/book`
- Supports Memory Points for player recognition
- Stores data using YAML files
- Includes configurable messages and settings
- Supports optional DiscordSRV integration

## Commands

### Player Commands

- `/timeline` - View the server history timeline
- `/history` - Open the history GUI
- `/book` - Receive the written Memory Book
- `/memory profile <player>` - View memories related to a player
- `/memory points` - View Memory Points

### Admin Commands

- `/memory add` - Add a custom memory
- `/memory remove` - Remove a memory
- `/memory list` - List stored memories
- `/memory reload` - Reload the plugin
- `/memory season start <name>` - Start a new SMP season

## Optional DiscordSRV Support

MemoryBook can optionally send memory announcements to Discord through DiscordSRV.

If DiscordSRV is installed and enabled in the configuration, new memories can be posted to a Discord channel. If DiscordSRV is not installed, the plugin will still work normally.
